title: 011 异变突起012 参与超凡战斗
content_zh:
就在许临东察觉护法堂大门的门神帖封印松动之际。
青龙寺外一公里处的公园河道上，一道白昼下浅淡如影的痕迹掠过水面，飞速向着寺旁的烂尾楼逼近。
同一刻，河道对岸的树荫下，一道诡异女子身影骤然显现。
她手提雪亮直刀，披散长发，上身一件如血渍干涸的褐红吊带，下穿牛仔裤，脚踩鲜红高跟鞋，紧随那抹浅淡影子，朝烂尾楼方向疾行。
女子步态怪异，双腿似崴伤般扭曲摆动着。
按理这般走路的方式，很难提速。
可她每跨一步，身形便鬼魅般闪现在数十米外。
这是阴差鬼步！
她手中的直刀微微扬起，指向前方，仿佛刀身拖拽着一具行尸走肉在前行。
烂尾楼已越来越近。
但就在这时，后方四道人影疾追而来，奔行快得惊人。
尤其为首一名手提大刀的女子，百米速度竟突破四秒，胸前波涛随之剧烈起伏。
更令人心惊的是，随着她全力疾奔，身侧竟逐渐浮现两道诡谲虚影。
两道虚影如随从般探手架住她的双臂，令其如虎添翼，速度再增，直逼前方施展阴差鬼步的女子而去。
“队长小心！
等等我们！”
后方三人紧追，有人高喊。
“幽魂带着他们和邪异物一起来了！”
“动手！”
烂尾楼内，两道人影迅速冲出旧楼道。

墙角破缸里，同时爬出了一道孩童身影，眨眼消失无踪。
“卢倩带人到了，那邪异物也出现了。”
不远处厂房内，三道埋伏已久的人影蓄势待发。
“随时准备动手。
老鼠一冒头，全部拿下。
绝不能让他们用岳山庙那件邪异物冲击到青龙寺。”
一个高大人影豁然站起，他的身躯诡异地沉入地面，消失于土中。
天道序列八【土地】！
他才是本次行动的关键，拥有镇压全场的力量。
此刻他潜行地底，将在关键时刻封锁区域，断绝所有救世会邪恶成员的退路。
...
与此同时，青龙寺深处的护法堂门口。
得到许临东提醒，匆忙赶来的青龙寺镇守者袁景看见眼前的景象，脸色骤变。
只见护法堂大门正微微震动，门缝在震响中已张开约一厘米。
一股浓郁的阴冷诅咒气息，从中缓慢逸散而出。
“封印松动？不，是里面的邪异物在冲击门户……怎么回事？”
袁景陡然转头，怒视许临东和易千浔，身上爆发强横气势：“难道是你们带了邪异物进来？你们到底是什么目的？”
“喂，老头你胡说什么？”
易千浔顿时恼了，虽被对方的超凡气势压得心畏，但有许临东挡在前，她仍壮胆反驳：
“我们什么都没做，一来就发现这门不对，立刻通知你了！”

“老头？”
袁景脸更黑了。
content_en:
Just when Xu Lindong noticed that the seal of the door god seal on the door of the Dharma Protector Hall was loose.
On the park river one kilometer outside Qinglong Temple, a faint shadow-like trace in the daytime swept across the water, quickly approaching the unfinished building next to the temple.
At the same moment, a strange female figure suddenly appeared under the shade of the trees on the other side of the river.
She was carrying a sharp straight knife, her hair was loose, she wore a maroon sling that looked like dried blood on her upper body, jeans, and bright red high heels. She followed the faint shadow and walked quickly in the direction of the unfinished building.
The woman's gait was strange, and her legs were twisted and swinging like sprains.
Logically speaking, walking like this would make it difficult to speed up.
But every time she took a step, her figure flashed dozens of meters away like a ghost.
This is a sinister move!
The straight knife in her hand was slightly raised and pointed forward, as if the blade was dragging a walking corpse forward.
The unfinished building is getting closer and closer.
But at this moment, four figures from behind were chasing after him, running at an alarming speed.
Especially the first woman, who was carrying a big knife, could reach 100 meters in 4 seconds, causing waves in her chest to rise and fall violently.
What was even more shocking was that as she ran with all her strength, two strange shadows gradually appeared beside her.
The two phantoms stretched out their hands to hold her arms like followers, making them even more powerful. Their speed increased again, and they rushed towards the woman in front of her who was using the evil step.
"Captain, be careful!
Wait for us! "
Three people were chasing after them, and someone shouted.
"The ghost brought them here with the evil alien object!"
"Do it!"
In the unfinished building, two figures quickly rushed out of the old corridor.
In the broken vat in the corner, a child figure crawled out at the same time and disappeared without a trace in the blink of an eye.
"Lu Qian and her people arrived, and the evil foreign object also appeared."
In a factory not far away, three figures who had been lying in wait for a long time were ready to attack.
“Always ready to take action.
The rats showed up and captured them all.
They must not be allowed to use the evil foreign object from Yueshan Temple to attack Qinglong Temple. "
A tall figure suddenly stood up, and his body sank into the ground strangely, disappearing into the earth.
Heavenly Sequence Eight [Land]!
He is the key to this operation and has the power to suppress the entire crowd.
At this moment, he is sneaking underground and will seal off the area at the critical moment and cut off the escape route of all the evil members of the Salvation Society.
...
At the same time, at the entrance of the Dharma Protector Hall deep in Qinglong Temple.
After being reminded by Xu Lindong, Yuan Jing, the guardian of Qinglong Temple who hurried over, saw the scene in front of him and his expression suddenly changed.
I saw that the door of the Dharma Protector Hall was shaking slightly, and the crack in the door had opened about one centimeter due to the shaking.
A strong, cold and cursed aura slowly escaped from it.
"The seal is loose? No, it's the evil foreign objects inside that are attacking the portal... What's going on?"
Yuan Jing suddenly turned his head and glared at Xu Lindong and Yi Qianxun, with a tyrannical aura erupting from his body: "Did you bring evil objects in? What is your purpose?"
"Hey, old man, what are you talking about?"
Yi Qianxun was immediately annoyed. Although she was overwhelmed by the opponent's extraordinary aura, she still had the courage to retort with Xu Lindong standing in front of her:
"We didn't do anything. We found something wrong with this door as soon as we came here, and we informed you immediately!"
"Old man?"
Yuan Jing's face turned darker.
